title: 环球旅人
concept: 金色旅行箱站在小地球奖杯上背后有抽象金色靠山光环
revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art for achievement_medal_travel_tier_006, to be converted into a transparent 768x768 app asset
Primary request: Create one absurd but premium collectible travel achievement medal for the Chinese title concept "环球旅人" (global traveler whose achievement comes from a powerful backer). The image itself must contain no text.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal, full object visible with generous padding. The medal has a chunky beveled gold rim and a deep glossy turquoise enamel center. Main visual gag: ONE shiny gold travel suitcase standing triumphantly on ONE tiny blue-green globe trophy pedestal, with a large abstract golden backing halo behind it like a powerful patron or "靠山". The backing halo is not a real person, not a hand, and not text; it is a simple raised gold arch silhouette behind the suitcase. The suitcase remains the dominant readable shape.
Style/medium: polished mobile game collectible, semi-3D hand-painted enamel pin / toy medal hybrid, playful deliberate nonsense, premium material finish, raised gold metal, glossy enamel, crisp edges, shiny highlights, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: final-tier medal, suitcase centered and dominant, tiny globe pedestal clearly below it, abstract backing halo clearly behind it, full medal visible with generous padding, no cropping.
Lighting/mood: triumphant global luxury, bright studio rim light, candy-like specular highlights, strongest celebratory glow of the travel set, ridiculous but prestigious.
Color palette: saturated metallic gold suitcase and halo, deep electric turquoise enamel, simple blue-green globe pedestal, coral or ruby rim accents, white-gold glints. Do not use #ff00ff anywhere in the medal or subject.
Materials/textures: raised gold metal, glossy enamel, lacquered toy-like surfaces, tiny globe trophy, abstract gold halo, beveled rim, smooth hand-painted shading. No paper grain.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no people, no animals, no real hands, no face in the halo, no maps with details, no compass, no leaves, no ticket, no camera, no neck pillow, no blanket, no airplane, no seat, no drink cup, no rocket, no fireball, no explosion, no smoke cloud, no gold bars, no coins, no money pile, no confetti, no crown, no postage stamp edge, no paper texture, no vintage scrapbook look, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
